diagnoses.cause: refreshCommercialDependencies passes the previous product/plan to paintSelect; paintSelect explicitly re-inserts a preferred value that is absent from the new upstream option set. A Ramo change can therefore retain an incompatible Producto/Plan.
diagnoses.fix: On upstream change, clear incompatible downstream values instead of re-inserting them; preserve only values present in the newly scoped set.
diagnoses.proof: Change Ramo across incompatible product sets; Producto becomes placeholder immediately, Plan clears, save+reload stays coherent.

diagnoses.cause: Aseguradoras de interés is rendered as native <select multiple>; desktop multi-select depends on Ctrl/Command and mobile affordance is not explicit.
diagnoses.fix: Replace native multiple interaction with explicit checkbox/chip/token selector while preserving country scope and stored insurer IDs.
diagnoses.proof: Desktop+390px: select/deselect multiple insurers without modifier keys; save+reload persists exact set.

diagnoses.cause: calidad.js state/header contains ffalta, soloVig and asesor but no text query; the prior search control is absent from the current render contract.

diagnoses.cause: Quality uses a wide table inside overflow-x:auto while the right action cell is white-space:nowrap; narrow viewports can place actions offscreen without a persistent affordance.

diagnoses.cause: Policy qualityBlock renders raw motivosPendientes/motivosCalidad strings after only underscore replacement/lowercasing; policy bridge errorText also falls back to raw internal error codes. Internal/HTML-like source tokens can therefore become user-facing text.

diagnoses.proof: DOM/text scan of policy detail+edit contains no raw internal token, raw tag text, source identifier or unmapped error code.

diagnoses.cause: On B4 Preview hosts batchDurable routes to orbit360ProductOperationalCommandPreview; executePreview rejects every non-synthetic document ID and requires __syntheticQa=true. Editing a real policy in Preview is therefore correctly denied, but policy-receipts-engine collapses the backend reason into operacion_atomica_no_confirmada and the bridge displays that unmapped technical code.
diagnoses.fix: Do not weaken Preview isolation. Detect/translate Preview real-record write denial, and prove the exact write contract with an equivalent b4003qa_* synthetic policy+receipts+portfolio fixture and cleanup.
diagnoses.proof: Carlos/Operativo: exact real policy remains protected in Preview with human message; synthetic equivalent proves before→renewability change→server commit→canonical readback→reload→receipt consistency→cleanup. LIVE write remains reserved for LIVE gate.

diagnoses.cause: Inicio gates advisor board on productionReadiness==='ready' && metaReadiness==='ready', but the fallback always says 'Actualizando producción y metas...' and does not distinguish denied/unavailable/missing configuration. A terminal non-ready state therefore looks like endless hydration.
diagnoses.fix: Render bounded readiness states (loading/unavailable/meta-not-configured/ready), rerender on relevant collection readiness, and never leave a terminal unavailable state as 'Actualizando'.
diagnoses.proof: Login→Inicio reaches a deterministic terminal state without refresh; metas/advisor board either renders data or a truthful terminal explanation within the startup threshold.

diagnoses.cause: Typed collaboration is stored as negocios.comentarios/bitacora through update_business. The existing outbox is generic and advisor-targeted; it has no typed handoff recipient/direction contract, Preview suppresses notificationOutbox creation, and the inbox therefore cannot prove request→intended recipient notification→case navigation for both advisor and operations directions.
diagnoses.fix: Reuse the existing canonical workflow/outbox/inbox. Add an explicit typed collaboration event/direction contract and internal recipient semantics after canonical commit; keep external email delivery as separate debt.
diagnoses.proof: Synthetic Preview path proves commit then durable internal notice for request→advisor, response→operations, recipient inbox/badge, case navigation and reload; no external-delivery claim.
